name: Cook Me Pasta Remastered
tagline: Push the ingredients together — in the right order.
description: Cook pasta in trattorias, restaurants and a busy market. Boil the pasta, mix tomato and tuna into sauce, then bring them together for the perfect meal — but never mix pasta with the sauce ingredients. Keys open locked pantries and kitchens.
win_text: Buon appetito! The meal is served.
lose_text: Ruined! Those ingredients don't go together.
